meta.title: Family Guardian: know where your child's time goes online
meta.description: A free browser extension and dashboard for parents. See which websites your child uses and for how long, block the ones you choose, and keep their privacy.

hero.title: Know where your child's time goes online
hero.subtitle: Family Guardian shows which websites your child uses on their Windows laptop and for how long. Block the ones you choose and get a daily focus score. It is free and only collects domains and time.

signIn.title: Sign in with Google
signIn.text: Use your own Google account to open your parent dashboard.

child.title: Add a child and pair the laptop
child.text: Create a profile for your child and enter the pairing code in the extension.

install.title: Install on Windows
install.text: Run one small file on your child's laptop to add the browser extension.

dashboard.title: See the dashboard
dashboard.text: Check activity, set blocks and read the daily focus score from any device.

activity.title: Activity by domain and time
activity.text: See which sites your child visits and how many minutes each day.

blocking.title: Site and category blocking
blocking.text: Block single sites or whole categories, and set daily time limits.

score.title: Daily focus score
score.text: One simple number that shows how focused the day was.

alerts.title: Offline alerts and digest
alerts.text: Get a note when the extension goes quiet and a weekly summary by e-mail.

privacy.title: Privacy-first
privacy.text: No page addresses, no content, no spying. Your child's browsing stays private.

privacy.title: Privacy comes first
privacy.intro: Family Guardian collects the least it needs to help you. Nothing more.

collected.domain: The website domain, such as example.com

footer.note: Family Guardian is free and not commercial.

meta.title: Setup guide: install Family Guardian on your child's laptop
meta.description: Step by step: sign in, add your child, get a pairing code, install the extension on Windows and check the dashboard.

setup.title: Setup guide
setup.intro: Follow these eight steps in order. It takes about ten minutes.

steps.signIn: Sign in as a parent with your Google account.
steps.child: Add your child in the dashboard.
steps.code: Get a pairing code for your child's laptop. It is valid for 1 hour.
steps.installer: On your child's Windows laptop, run the .reg installer as administrator.
steps.standard: Make sure your child uses a Standard (not Administrator) Windows account.
steps.restart: Fully close and reopen Chrome, Edge and Brave.
steps.pair: Open the extension and enter the pairing code.
steps.dashboard: Check the dashboard: the laptop should show as online within a few minutes.

setup.installLink: Open the install page for the files

meta.title: FAQ: common questions about Family Guardian
meta.description: Answers about what is collected, supported browsers, blocking, the focus score, alerts, deleting data and who can see it.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Only the domain of each website (for example example.com) and the seconds spent on it, plus the browser, Windows and the extension version. It never collects full URLs, page titles, page content, searches, keystrokes or screenshots.
faq.a2: Chrome, Edge and Brave on Windows laptops.
faq.q3: Can my child turn off Family Guardian?
faq.a3: A Standard Windows account cannot remove the extension. Incognito and guest windows are switched off by the installer, so they cannot be used to hide browsing.
faq.a4: Yes. Block single sites or whole categories from the dashboard and set daily time limits. Changes reach the laptop within a few minutes.
faq.a5: A single number for each day: the share of time on your homework sites, minus a penalty for switching.
faq.a6: You get a note when the extension has not reported for a while. A laptop that is switched off looks the same as a removed extension, so check that the laptop is on first.
faq.q7: How do I manage children and devices?
faq.a7: Add each child in the dashboard, then pair each of their laptops with its own pairing code. One child can have several devices.
faq.q8: Can I delete a child or my data?
faq.a8: A child can be deleted in the dashboard, which removes their data. Deleting a whole account is done on request: use the contact on the privacy page.
faq.a9: Yes. It is free and not commercial.
faq.q10: Who can see my child's data?
faq.a10: Only the parents of your family who sign in to the dashboard. Nobody else can see it.
faq.a11: Usage data is kept for 13 months and then removed.

meta.title: Help: fix common Family Guardian problems
meta.description: Troubleshooting: extension not showing, device offline, pairing code expired, blocked site still opens, e-mails not arriving.

help.title: Help and troubleshooting
help.intro: Find your problem below and try the steps in order.
help.contactText: Write to us and we will help:

s1.title: The extension is not showing
s1.text: The extension is installed by the .reg file and only appears after the browser restarts.
s1.step1: Fully close and reopen the browser.
s1.step2: Open the browser's extensions page and check that Family Guardian is listed.
s1.step3: If it is missing, run the installer again as administrator.

s2.title: The device shows offline
s2.text: A laptop that is switched off looks the same as a removed extension.
s2.step1: Turn on the laptop and open the browser.
s2.step2: Wait a few minutes for the next report.
s2.step3: If it stays offline, check the extension is still enabled.

s3.title: The pairing code expired
s3.text: A pairing code is valid for 1 hour. Getting a new code replaces the old one.
s3.step1: Open the child in the dashboard.
s3.step3: Enter the new code in the extension within 1 hour.

s4.title: A blocked site still opens
s4.text: New rules reach the laptop within a few minutes.
s4.step1: Wait a few minutes and reload the page.
s4.step2: Check the site's domain is in the block list.
s4.step3: Make sure the browser was restarted after installing.

s5.title: E-mails are not arriving
s5.text: Alerts and weekly reports are sent to your sign-in e-mail address.
s5.step1: Check the spam or junk folder.
s5.step2: In Settings, check the e-mail digest time, and turn on Weekly report if you want it.
s5.step3: Add the sender to your contacts.
